question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Impress
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Influence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Impress"** in English means to affect deeply or strongly in mind or feelings; impact (प्रभावित करना).

 
 
• **Example: **The candidate managed to impress the interviewers with her adept problem-solving abilities.
 
 
 
• The term **"Influence"** refers to the power to change or affect someone or something; the power to cause changes without directly forcing them to happen (प्रभाव).
 
 
• **Example: **His public speeches have the power to influence the mindset of the youth.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is - **'Influence'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Anxious'** (Option 1) describes a state of unease, such as worry or fear, about a possible future event (चिंतित).
 
• '**Endure' **(Option 2) means to suffer something difficult, painful, or unpleasant patiently (सहन करना).
 
• **'Suffice'** (Option 4) means to be enough or adequate, usually used in the context of needs or requirements (पर्याप्त होना).
